prediction.rationale:
Cooler: close to total failure. Evidence: TS4 mean temperature 52.5 °C (69% above healthy); TS3 mean temperature 58.7 °C (51% above healthy); TS1 mean temperature 57.2 °C (59% above healthy). Rapid temperature accumulation with minimal inlet-outlet drop indicates loss of cooling circulation.
Valve: optimal. Evidence: PS2 pressure rise time 9.40 s (within 1% of healthy); PS1/PS2 valve switching lag 9.65 s (within 2% of healthy). Directional valve actuates cleanly with no discernible switching hesitation.
Pump leakage: weak leakage. Evidence: FS1 mean volume flow 4.34 l/min (34% below healthy); EPS1/FS1 power-to-flow ratio 581 W·min/l (52% above healthy); SE system efficiency factor 39.9 % (32% below healthy). Volumetric delivery is slightly compromised due to minor internal bypass flow.
Accumulator: close to total failure. Evidence: PS2 pressure ripple 53.7 bar (15% above healthy). Marked pressure ripple and reduced peak pressure indicate severe loss of hydraulic accumulator gas pre-charge.
